title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for US agent payments
summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet, a payment wallet that lets AI agents make purchases without receiving the user&\#x27;s real card number, in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa. OpenAI says it is available starting today in the US through dots to ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and older who use a US-issued card. For each purchase, the user reviews the item and amount and confirms with Face ID or a fingerprint, while the card network issues a payment token that substitutes for the real card number. The announcement presents these capabilities as launching, but the item comes from a Telegram aggregator and provides no independent verification or details on availability outside the US.
